nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines core agent-org-run domain types (status, entry mode, run context, participants, routing decisions) plus the routing/authorization rules governing which org members may message or assign tasks to each other.
nodes.languageNotes: AgentOrgRunContext centralizes hierarchy-aware authorization (routing, task assignment) computed from a snapshot of org membership.

nodes.name: as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the string wire representation of this enum value (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a string into the corresponding enum value (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the string wire representation of this enum value (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a string into the corresponding enum value (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: is_terminal
nodes.summary: Checks whether this status represents a terminal (no-further-transitions) state (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: coordinator_participant
nodes.summary: Returns the coordinator's AgentOrgParticipant entry from the run context.

nodes.name: participants
nodes.summary: Returns the full flattened list of participants in the run context.

nodes.name: participant_by_member_id
nodes.summary: Looks up a participant by member id within the run context.

nodes.name: participant_display_name
nodes.summary: Resolves the display name for a participant by member id.

nodes.name: participant_agent_id
nodes.summary: Resolves the underlying agent id for a participant by member id.

nodes.name: require_participant
nodes.summary: Looks up participant and returns an error if it cannot be found (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: require_participant_display_name
nodes.summary: Looks up participant display name and returns an error if it cannot be found (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: require_participant_agent_id
nodes.summary: Looks up participant agent id and returns an error if it cannot be found (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: allowed_recipient_member_ids_for
nodes.summary: Computes the set of member ids a given sender is allowed to message directly, based on the run's hierarchy mode (flat vs strict tree routing).

nodes.name: direct_report_member_ids_for
nodes.summary: Returns the member ids of direct reports for a given manager member id.

nodes.name: allowed_task_target_member_ids_for
nodes.summary: Computes which member ids a given caller is allowed to assign tasks to.

nodes.name: can_assign_task_to
nodes.summary: Checks whether can assign task to (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: check_routing
nodes.summary: Checks whether a message from one member to another is allowed under the run's routing rules, returning an Allowed/Blocked decision.

nodes.name: init_schema
nodes.summary: Creates the agent_org_runs table and its indexes if they do not already exist.

nodes.name: AgentOrgRunEntryMode
nodes.summary: Enum type with variants: StandaloneSession (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: AgentOrgRunStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of agent org run lifecycle states (Running, Paused, Completed, Failed, Cancelled, Abandoned) with wire (de)serialization and terminal-state checking.

nodes.name: AgentOrgContextMember
nodes.summary: Data record with fields: member_id, name, role, agent_id, parent_member_id (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: AgentOrgParticipant
nodes.summary: Data record with fields: member_id, agent_id, parent_member_id, is_coordinator (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: AgentOrgCompletionSnapshot
nodes.summary: Snapshot summarizing whether an agent org run is complete: run status, tasks, active members/interventions, and pending counts.

nodes.name: AgentOrgRunContext
nodes.summary: Runtime context describing an agent org run: its participants, hierarchy mode, and plan-approval policy, exposing authorization queries for messaging and task assignment.

nodes.name: RoutingDecision
nodes.summary: Enum representing the outcome of a message-routing authorization check (Allowed or Blocked).

nodes.name: AgentOrgRunRecord
nodes.summary: Persisted record of an agent org run: coordinator, root session, org snapshot, status, and linkage to work items/routines.

nodes.name: CreateAgentOrgRunParams
nodes.summary: Data record with fields: org_id, coordinator_agent_id, root_session_id, org_snapshot, entry_mode, status, work_item_id, project_slug (agent org run domain types and routing rules).

nodes.name: store.rs
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed persistence store for agent org runs: creation, pause/resume/fail transitions, startup reconciliation, run-finality detection, completion snapshots, and lookups of worker/coordinator sessions by member.
nodes.languageNotes: reconcile_run_finality and completion_snapshot implement large, multi-condition state machines for deciding when a multi-agent run is actually done.

nodes.name: session_is_quiescent_for_completed_run
nodes.summary: Checks whether a session's status is one that counts as quiescent (no further activity expected) for a completed run.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Inserts a new agent org run record and initializes its associated bookkeeping state.

nodes.name: mark_paused
nodes.summary: Transitions an agent org run's status to Paused.

nodes.name: mark_all_running_as_paused_on_startup
nodes.summary: On application startup, pauses any runs left in the Running state from before the previous shutdown/crash.

nodes.name: requeue_abandoned_member_tasks_on_startup
nodes.summary: On startup, requeues tasks owned by members whose sessions were abandoned before the previous shutdown.

nodes.name: reconcile_resolved_running_runs_on_startup
nodes.summary: On startup, re-evaluates finality for runs that were left Running but whose work already completed.

nodes.name: mark_resumed
nodes.summary: Transitions a paused agent org run's status back to Running.

nodes.name: mark_failed
nodes.summary: Marks an agent org run as Failed, recording the error message.

nodes.name: reconcile_run_finality
nodes.summary: Core state-machine function that inspects an agent org run's tasks, sessions, and interventions to decide whether the run should transition to Completed/Abandoned/Failed, applying the resulting status update.

nodes.name: context_for_run
nodes.summary: Loads an agent org run and builds its AgentOrgRunContext.

nodes.name: context_for_session_with_parent_walk
nodes.summary: Resolves the owning agent org run context for a session by walking up its parent-session chain until a run root is found.

nodes.name: root_session_id_for_session_with_parent_walk
nodes.summary: Resolves just the root session id for a session by delegating to the parent-walk context lookup.

nodes.name: run_id_for_session_with_parent_walk
nodes.summary: Resolves just the owning run id for a session by delegating to the parent-walk context lookup.

nodes.name: is_root_session
nodes.summary: Checks whether is root session (the agent org run persistence store).

nodes.name: run_for_session_with_parent_walk
nodes.summary: Walks up a session's parent chain to find the agent org run record that owns it, breaking on cycles.

nodes.name: list_runs
nodes.summary: Lists the most recent agent org runs up to a limit.

nodes.name: list_running_runs
nodes.summary: Lists agent org runs currently in the Running status.

nodes.name: get_run_status
nodes.summary: Retrieves run status (the agent org run persistence store).

nodes.name: completion_snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds a full AgentOrgCompletionSnapshot for a run by aggregating task list, active member ids, active interventions, and pending counts.

nodes.name: delete_by_id
nodes.summary: Deletes an agent org run record by id.

nodes.name: find_worker_session_by_member_id
nodes.summary: Finds the worker session associated with a given org run and member id.

nodes.name: find_coordinator_session_by_member_id
nodes.summary: Finds the coordinator session for a given org run and member id, handling CLI-agent session variants.

nodes.name: list_worker_sessions_by_member_ids
nodes.summary: Lists worker session runtime info for a set of member ids within a run.

nodes.name: list_descendant_worker_sessions
nodes.summary: Lists all descendant worker sessions under an agent org run's root session, including intervention status per session.

nodes.name: AgentOrgRunStore
nodes.summary: The primary persistence and lifecycle-management store for agent org runs: creation, status transitions, startup recovery, finality reconciliation, and session lookups.
